subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for receiving, tracking, and responding to complaints, concerns, and questions from individuals about organizational privacy practices are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IP-3 (Individual Participation in the Information Security Program — privacy analogue)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.2 (responsibilities for receiving complaints)
GDPR Art. 12-22 (Rights of the data subject), Art. 77 (Right to lodge complaint with supervisory authority)
implementation_examples: Establish intake, tracking, and response procedures for complaints, concerns, and questions from individuals about organisational privacy practices
Provide convenient channels (intake form, email, phone, postal) consistent with accessibility requirements
Respond within the timeframes set by applicable law (e.g., one month under GDPR Art. 12(3))
assessment_objectives: Determine whether intake channels exist for individual complaints
Determine whether complaints are tracked individually through to closure
Determine whether responses are issued within legal timeframes
Determine whether repeat topics drive policy/process improvements
